conclusion: The authors' public file contained 729 learner–problem records. On 584 matched out-of-time learner-held-out observations, first-correct F1 was 0.676 for the past-only model. In the independent code archive, 27 incorrect programs removed from the list being traversed.

next_decision: Use the two interactive feedback variants for a future learner-randomized study. Historical hint use is observational and cannot measure which prototype improves independent transfer.

study_design.protocol: Use the 2019 challenge authors' public predictions and real first-correct, any-hint and attempt records. Hold out entire learners and mature earlier learners before fitting. Independently inspect real duplicate-removal attempts in the Refactory corpus. Build two runnable feedback designs and specify equal exposure, a new transfer item and a prospective learner-randomized evaluation.
